name: Coffee filters
description: Falling coffee filters: linear or quadratic drag? The green rectangle taped to the wall is a credit card (85.6 mm long side).

proposal.feasibility_note: Recommend 4 filters because it is the feasible setting with the largest physical effect (67% difference in the predicted observable) among settings that separate the models by ≥10σ. Expected separation 287.9σ RMS (max 469σ) after the 0.5 s conditioning window. Compare 0.2σ at the current setting (1 filters). Larger values were avoided because stacks above 5 filters tend to tumble.
proposal.filming_instructions: Stack 4 coffee filters (nested), drop them from the same height (~2 m) in front of the same wall, with the camera and reference card unchanged.
